description: This file defines the WindowManagerState class and related functions for creating and managing window state representations in an Android window management context. It includes methods for parsing protocol buffer data into internal representations, handling timestamps, and creating related objects like policies and containers.

classes.name: WindowManagerState
classes.description: Represents the state of the window manager, including methods to parse protocol buffer data into this state.

methods.name: fromProto
methods.description: Creates a WindowManagerState instance from protocol buffer data, with options for timestamp handling.
